x-okf-proposal-guidance.summary: the reader wants to understand why; an argument for why something is the way it is.
x-okf-proposal-guidance.question: Does the reader want to understand why?
signals: context comes before the idea itself
there are no steps to follow and nothing to look up
a reader could restate the idea in their own words afterwards
anti_signals: the page prescribes an order of operations
the page is a table of facts
the reader is expected to type along
x-okf-proposal-guidance.title_pattern: Frames a concept: `How ... works`, `Understanding ...`, `Why ... is designed this way`
